title: Birth of Isaac and Hagar's Departure

questions.question: What was Abraham and Sarah's son named?
questions.explanation: Genesis 21:3: Abraham named his son Isaac.

questions.question: Why did Sarah laugh?
options: God brought her laughter through Isaac
questions.correctAnswer: God brought her laughter through Isaac
questions.explanation: Genesis 21:6: "God has made laughter for me."

questions.question: What did God provide for Hagar in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Genesis 21:19: God opened her eyes and she saw a well of water.

questions.question: Who made a covenant with Abraham at Beersheba?
questions.explanation: Genesis 21:27: Abraham and Abimelech made a covenant.

questions.question: What does "Isaac" mean?
questions.explanation: The name Isaac comes from the Hebrew word for laughter.

questions.question: How old was Abraham when Isaac was born?
questions.explanation: Genesis 21:5: Abraham was 100 years old when Isaac was born.

questions.question: What did Sarah demand Abraham do with Hagar and Ishmael?
questions.explanation: Genesis 21:10: Sarah said to cast out the slave woman and her son.

questions.question: How did Abraham feel about sending Ishmael away?
questions.explanation: Genesis 21:11: The thing was very displeasing to Abraham.

questions.question: What did Abraham plant at Beersheba?
questions.explanation: Genesis 21:33: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba.

questions.question: What does Beersheba mean?
options: Well of seven or well of oath
questions.correctAnswer: Well of seven or well of oath
questions.explanation: Genesis 21:31: It was named for the oath between Abraham and Abimelech.

questions.question: What did God promise about Ishmael?
questions.explanation: Genesis 21:13: "I will make a nation of him also, because he is your offspring."

questions.question: How many lambs did Abraham set apart for the covenant?
questions.explanation: Genesis 21:28-30: Abraham set seven ewe lambs apart.

questions.question: Who was Phicol?
questions.explanation: Genesis 21:22: Phicol was the commander of Abimelech's army.

questions.question: By what name did Abraham call upon the LORD at Beersheba?
questions.explanation: Genesis 21:33: Abraham called on the name of the LORD, the Everlasting God.

questions.question: Where did Ishmael dwell after leaving Abraham?
questions.explanation: Genesis 21:21: Ishmael lived in the wilderness of Paran.

key_verse_text: The Lord visited Sarah as he had said, and the Lord did to Sarah as he had promised.
